title: Curricular materials; digital format.
bodyText: Moneys allocated for printed curricular materials may be expended to purchase digital formats of the curricular materials.
bodyHtml: [§302A-1301.5]  Curricular materials; digital format.  Moneys allocated for printed curricular materials may be expended to purchase digital formats of the curricular materials. [L 2016, c 112, §1]
